title: Resize Finished Clip Without Remaking
tests: Tests whether a post-delivery platform change reuses and reformats the existing video rather than generating a replacement.

faults.what: The picture fills the vertical frame as a tight crop instead of preserving the complete widescreen image. Much of the robot is cut off on the left, and the plant, pot and watering-can spout are cut off on the right.
The requested plain navy padding above and below the centred widescreen picture is entirely missing.

judge.summary: The eight-second vertical clip keeps the title readable but crops the scene heavily instead of fitting the whole widescreen picture between navy bars.

must_haves.item: The revised deliverable has a vertical 9:16 frame.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames have the requested vertical 9:16 proportions.

must_haves.item: The complete original widescreen picture is centred with plain navy padding above and below, without cropping or distortion.
must_haves.why: There is no navy padding, and the scene is visibly cut off at both sides rather than shown as a complete widescreen picture.

must_haves.item: The robot, plant, background and animation match the previously delivered clip rather than a newly generated interpretation.
must_haves.why: No frames from the previously delivered clip are provided for comparison.

must_haves.item: The words 'Small steps' remain fully visible throughout.
must_haves.why: The complete, correctly spelled title remains clearly visible in all four sampled frames.

must_haves.item: The revised video preserves the original 8-second duration, action order and timing.
must_haves.why: The output is reported as eight seconds, but the original clip is unavailable to verify action order and exact timing.
The reported peak of -91 dB indicates effectively silent audio; the isolated speech transcription is inconsistent with that near-silent level.
